Plus, Amazon stacks up | Tuesday, November 24, 2026
 
View in browser
 
PRESENTED BY J.P. MORGAN
 
Axios Pro Rata
By Dan Primack · Nov 24, 2026

⬇️ Situational awareness: Anthropic shares this morning fell below their $83 IPO price in premarket trading. As a reminder, first post-IPO trades last Thursday were $111.50 per share.
Share today’s Axios Pro Rata
 
 
Top of the Morning
 

Photo illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios. Photo: Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg via Getty Images
 

We don't know why Nvidia's board fired Jensen Huang two weeks ago. We also don't know why they rehired him yesterday.

  • All of the celebration and condemnation are educated guesses at best and ignorant noise at worst.

If the company and its CEO are really too big to fail — linchpins to America's economy and tech sovereignty — then the American people deserve answers as to what actually happened.

  • Nvidia's board and Jensen himself should stop hiding behind PR pablum and share facts. Even if they are uncomfortable.

Was he fired because: He was sleeping with an alleged spy? He was sleeping with a major customer? He was sleeping with a direct report? Other employees too? He lied to the board? He shared sensitive information with someone he shouldn't? He sidestepped U.S. export controls? He was at serious risk of prosecution? Fears of investor lawsuits?

Was he reinstated because: She definitely wasn't a spy? President Trump promised that Jensen wouldn't be prosecuted, or that he'd get a preemptive pardon? Other political pressures? The value destruction was too great? Board members were being ostracized? Employees adored him? Fears of investor lawsuits?

  • There have been reports and speculation about all of the above, but we don't actually know any of it.
  • The resignation and reinstatement announcements were bereft of such details, despite the trillions of dollars that moved on these choices.

The bottom line: There is bipartisan fervor in Congress for investigations, and Nvidia claims that its own independent inquiry is ongoing.

  • The former risks becoming a political circus, and the latter at this point feels pro forma.
  • Eleven people have definitive answers. It's time for them to share.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Annelise Capossela/Axios
 

Amazon (Nasdaq: AMZN) has agreed to buy the chip optimization software assets of Decart, an Israeli developer of world models, for a reported $7.5 billion.

  • Decart's founding team and a group of its engineers will join Amazon, which is not purchasing Decart's world models.

Why it's the BFD: Big Tech keeps seeking to sidestep antitrust scrutiny by structuring multibillion-dollar AI deals as asset sales instead of as corporate acquisitions.

Catch up quick: Decart has raised over $450m in VC funding from firms like Radical Ventures, Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, Aleph VC, and Zeev Ventures.

  • It previously held sale talks with Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT).

The bottom line: "Amazon, which has so far been using its Trainium chips at its own data centers, is preparing to start selling them to customers as a competitor to Nvidia. Decart's technology could make it easier for customers to run their workloads on Amazon chips, rather than Nvidia's, which has been the gold standard so far." — Rebecca Bellan, TechCrunch
 
 
Venture Capital Deals
 

• Marlowe, an AI cloud infrastructure developer, raised $277m in seed funding at a $1.15b valuation. Accel led, joined by Bessemer Venture Partners, Altimeter Capital Management, Atreides Management, Valor Ventures, and Neo. axios.link/4iZmoID

• Embo, a developer of robot "brains," raised $110m in seed funding. A16z led, joined by Khosla Ventures, DST Global, NVentures, and Striker Venture Partners. axios.link/4j1m9wQ

🚑 Ritzey Therapeutics, a developer of treatments for metabolic and neurological conditions, raised $112.5m in Series A funding. Vida Ventures led, joined by EcoR1 Capital, Fidelity, Perceptive Advisors, Montanova, Alexandria Venture Investments, and FMB Research. axios.link/4A7cTNG

• Simplexity Robotics, a Chinese humanoid robotics startup, raised $100m in pre-Series A funding at a $1.6b valuation. Ant Group led, joined by Alibaba, Tencent, HongShan Capital, and Lanchi Ventures. axios.link/4zAIohR

🚀 Myriota, an Australian satellite startup, raised A$60m in Series C funding. NRFC and Main Sequence Ventures led, joined by Hostplus and Funds SA. axios.link/3UUVzw6

• Trustly, a Swedish digital payments company, raised $60m from insiders Nordic Capital, Alfvén & Didrikson, and BlackRock. axios.link/49jrAkJ

• Zipher, an Israeli startup that rebuilds enterprise data platforms for agents, raised $53m in seed and Series A funding from TLV Partners, Maor Investments, and Glilot Capital. zipher.ai

• Supertake, a platform for turning personal predictions into investment portfolios, raised $20m in seed funding. Adjacent led, joined by Coinbase Ventures and Union Square Ventures. axios.link/3XLnf7p

• Ionic Wealth, an Indian wealth-tech platform, raised $19.1m led by Angel One. axios.link/4tgdp9x

• Matters AI, an Indian enterprise data security startup, raised $12m. Tanglin Venture Partners led, joined by IIFL Fintech Fund, Piper Serica's BharatTech Fund, Foster Ventures, Tetration Ventures, Kalaari Capital, and Endiya Partners. axios.link/4j9NZpl

⚡ Lumora Technologies, a decision engine for power markets, raised $11.7m from firms like General Catalyst and XYZ. axios.link/3VKiEll

• Q.security, a post-quantum cryptography remediation platform, raised $11.5m in seed funding. Castle Island Ventures led, joined by New York Life Ventures and Coinbase Ventures. axios.link/4l8aVI7

• Intelligent Legal Solutions, a platform for private investment funds lawyers, raised $11m in Series A funding. Aquiline and BlackFin Capital Partners led, joined by Chicago Ventures and The LegalTech Fund. axios.link/3VHHUsw

🚑 Leash Biosciences, a Salt Lake City-based automated laboratory and data-generation platform, raised $11 million in seed funding, per Axios Pro. Innovation Endeavors and Insight Partners led, joined by SpringTide Ventures, Top Harvest Capital, and Mitsui. axios.link/3Vjeu3N

🚑 Playbook, a German developer of operating procedures for AI agents working in pharma, raised €8m. Heal Capital led, joined by Bayern Kapital and Capnamic. axios.link/3WUfGLu

• InvoiceQ, a Jordanian e-invoicing and tax compliance startup, raised a $5m Series A. Manara Ventures and Next Ventures led, joined by Orange Ventures, the Innovative Startups and SMEs Fund, and the Jordan Small and Medium Enterprises Fund. axios.link/4iXaBur

• Pai Defence, the British-Ukrainian developer of anti-drone tech, raised $5m in pre-seed funding led by Gardar. axios.link/4lfujTs

• Verra, an NYC-based AI software developer for consulting firms, raised $5m in seed funding led by Kearny Jackson, per Axios Pro. axios.link/4CipYoG

• Miren, a platform for developers to run apps, raised $3m in pre-seed funding from BlueYard Capital and Union Square Ventures. axios.link/48HrdAm

• Backgrounder, a provider of anti-scam protections for consumers and businesses, raised $2m in seed financing led by Paladin Capital Group. axios.link/4jff0b1

Private Equity Deals
 

• Apis Partners acquired a majority stake in Korridor, a logistics fintech for cross-border transporters in Africa. axios.link/4ATWLza

• APP Jet Center, a Bain Capital portfolio company, agreed to acquire fixed-base operator Sheltair. axios.link/48CRD6l

• Bridgepoint agreed to buy a majority stake in Complii, a U.K. provider of building safety and regulatory compliance services, from Ansor. axios.link/4jbkvay

• Diatonic Healthcare acquired a majority stake in Smash Analytics, a Salt Lake City-based nearshore staffing platform. axios.link/4tdwtVH

• Harvest Partners acquired Good Peeps, a New York-based media agency for consumer brands. axios.link/48wyyml

🚑 Madison Dearborn Partners agreed to acquire Peli BioThermal, a Maple Grove, Minn.-based provider of temperature-controlled packaging solutions for the life sciences, from Platinum Equity. axios.link/4j9Nr2L

• Mubadala Capital acquired Arrive Logistics, an Austin-based truckload brokerage, from ATL Partners (which retains a stake). axios.link/4CkJnp1

• PACT Capital Partners acquired a minority stake in Elvaston Capital Management, a PE firm focused on enterprise software businesses in the DACH region. axios.link/49jBWkB

🚑 Sentinel Capital Partners acquired GSI Group, a Mahwah, N.J.-based supplier of branded laboratory consumables, from L Squared Capital Partners. axios.link/4zDyb4s

• Tikehau Capital acquired a majority stake in Sigma Components, a British maker of aerospace components. axios.link/4zAQPd7

🚑 TVM Capital Healthcare invested in Harvest Integrated Research Organization, a Somerset, N.J.-based contract research organization that will use proceeds to expand in Southeast Asia. harvestiro.com
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

🚑 Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) acquired LoQus23 Therapeutics, a British developer of Huntington's disease treatments, for up to $725m in cash. LoQus23 had raised $67m from firms like Forbion, Novartis Venture Fund, and SV Health Investors. axios.link/49c3jwW

• John Deere (NYSE: DE) acquired Orchard Robotics, an Ithaca, N.Y.-based AI farming platform for precision crop management. Orchard had raised $25m from firms like Shine Capital, Quiet Capital, General Catalyst, Contrary, and Ravelin Capital. axios.link/4A6gHPl
 
 
More M&A
 

• FrenchFry, a holding company for businesses run on a shared AI platform, agreed to go public at an implied $500m valuation via Tavia Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: TAVI). axios.link/49fB7t8

• Harbinger Motors, an EV truck maker, secured more than $100m in financing from Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank and Pinegrove Venture Partners, per Axios Pro. axios.link/4eWtwmG

• Linamar (TSX: LNR) agreed to acquire the Genie Access Work Platforms business from Terex (NYSE: TEX) for US$1.4b. axios.link/4tg1VTc

⚡ PPC Group of Greece agreed to acquire Italian energy trading and supply company Enegan for around €330m. axios.link/4eSVj7s

🚑 Sanofi (Nasdaq: SNY) agreed to acquire Insmed (Nasdaq: INSM), a New Jersey-based drugmaker focused on respiratory diseases, for $41b in cash, or $175 per share. It's the largest biotech deal in three years. axios.link/3X5OoBM

• Trian Fund Management is pushing Solventum (NYSE: SOLV) to spin off its health information systems business. axios.link/4ALD6B7
 
 
Fundraising
 

• Allegient Partners, a Hoboken, N.J.-based PE firm, is raising $50m for its second fund, per an SEC filing.

• British Business Bank invested £43m for a stake in Oxford Science Enterprises, a group that helps spin out University of Oxford research. axios.link/4AagvP4

• Carousel Capital Partners of Charlotte is raising its seventh flagship PE fund, per an SEC filing.

• CommerzVentures, a German VC firm focused on fintech, raised €50m for its fourth fund. axios.link/4AUu9pu

• Key1 Capital, an Israeli growth equity firm, held a $320m first close on its second fund. axios.link/4CirHuf

• Lok Capital, an Indian VC firm, held a $130m first close on a fifth fund targeting $250m. axios.link/4zF1CTw
 
 
It's Personnel
 

• John Dunnigan joined Nuveen Private Capital as a managing director and head of strategic relationships. He previously was with Golub Capital. axios.link/4jyDBZB

• The Riverside Co. named Joe Manning as managing partner for the firm's micro-cap strategy. axios.link/4zFNCsP

• Alex Tracy joined Evercore as a senior managing director in the firm's liability management and restructuring group. He previously was with Perella Weinberg Partners. axios.link/49gBxiQ
